hook: Your Jakarta trip is to a sinking city.
title: Your Jakarta Trip Is to a Sinking City
description:
Parts of Jakarta are sinking, partly because of groundwater pumping, and the coast floods. Indonesia is building a new capital, Nusantara, on Borneo, and the sinking is one reason for the move. Series: Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #Jakarta #Geography
comment_prompt: Would you live in Jakarta? Yes or no
